title: Shared provider runtime and Sourceright extraction
claim_boundary: Source-verified implementation only; higher evidence levels require the named open gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

assertions.statement: Inventory Sourceright live_providers and provider modules
open_gates: Refresh against the current Sourceright revision before cutover.
assertions.permitted_claim: The observed Sourceright provider surface is inventoried at a pinned revision.

assertions.statement: Define compatibility adapter and feature flag
open_gates: Compile the compatibility adapter in Searchright and Sourceright.
assertions.permitted_claim: A source compatibility adapter exists; downstream compilation is not proven.

assertions.statement: Port retries, cache, endpoint, rate and receipt behavior
open_gates: Prove cache and error parity against Sourceright.
Resolve, validate and pin accepted DNS answers in every live connector transport before closing H-002; literal and supplied-resolution denial logic is compiler-tested.
assertions.permitted_claim: The shared runtime and endpoint-address denial logic are compiler-tested; Sourceright parity and live transport DNS pinning are not proven.

assertions.statement: Run old/new fixture parity and snapshot differences
open_gates: Run old/new fixtures and compare every parity dimension.
assertions.permitted_claim: Parity cases are defined; dual-run results do not yet exist.

open_gates: Run cargo-semver-checks and public API snapshots after compiler bootstrap.
assertions.permitted_claim: SemVer and public API gates are configured but not executed.

assertions.statement: Switch Sourceright then remove superseded code after evidence
open_gates: Modify and test Sourceright through an approved downstream pull request.
Retain rollback for at least one compatible release.
assertions.permitted_claim: No Sourceright code has been removed or switched by this repository.
